label: Council tax
desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill

label: Revenue Support Grant
desc: The council's main general grant from government. From 2026/27 it includes funding that used to come through business rates and separate grants

label: Business rates kept locally
official_term: Retained income from Rate Retention Scheme
desc: The share of local business rates the council keeps

label: Schools grants (ring-fenced)
official_term: Dedicated Schools Grant and other education grants
desc: Passed to schools; cannot be spent on anything else

label: Public health grant (ring-fenced)
desc: Can only be spent on public health

label: Other government grants
official_term: Other specific and special grants within AEF
desc: Grants for adult care, children and families, homelessness and others, including the income protection floor

label: Council tax surplus and other
official_term: Collection fund surplus and other items
desc: Last year's council tax collected above estimate, and other items

label: Drawn from schools reserves
official_term: Appropriations from schools and DSG reserves

label: Drawn from council reserves
official_term: Appropriations from earmarked and unallocated reserves
desc: One-off: once spent, the gap returns the year after
